Offensive coordinator Pat Shurmur was impressed by the Vikings offensive line, saying they didn't make any "catastrophes" and they did "an overall good job."
"You can’t block for everybody, but I thought our guys did a good job of getting on the same page and working together." Vikings coach Mike Zimmer commented on the offensive line.

"You can’t block for everybody, but I thought our guys did a good job of getting on the same page and working together," Vikings coach Mike Zimmer said. "I don’t have any hesitation to feel good about the way they blocked. It’s on the guy to make the read, but if you watch it you definitely can’t rightfully criticize the time our linemen do their job. I think they did a good job of working together. I think it was a collective thing - there were no catastrophes, at least none that jumped off the tape, and they did an overall good job."
"We weren’t there on every single play by any means but I thought they did a pretty good job," Vikings offensive lineman Nick Easton said in a postgame interview on the NFL Network. "They mixed multiple coverages but you’re talking about a Super Bowl contending team that’s a top defense, I think that’s a pretty good start for a group of guys that haven’t played together."
